description.value: Armstrong Regional Co-op is a long-established member-owned cooperative that has held over 104 annual general meetings, serving the North Okanagan with gas bars, convenience stores, bulk fuel, propane, and a liquor store (ARC Liquor) across multiple community locations. The Armstrong location combines a fuel station with a convenience store, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through town. As a cooperative, profits are returned to members and reinvested in the local community.
